headline: VAT takes 7 times larger income share from poor than rich: Study
summary: The poorest 10% of households pay VAT equal to 20.37% of reported income, against 2.8% for the wealthiest 10%. The study points to a regressive tax burden.
why: Value-added tax is a major source of government revenue in Bangladesh and shapes consumer spending and fiscal policy. Its distributional effects can influence tax reform debates.
